headline: Skyward's storm now reads on a phone — vista, wind, crash and HUD polish shipped
lede: A QA-driven presentation pass on Skyward (the gyro flight game): the attract screen frames the sunlit volcano side instead of a grey backdrop, the storm mix separates on small speakers, each crash beat lands clean on a phone, and the HUD fits a 320-pixel screen. Rules and scoring untouched — the same high scores mean the same thing.

notes.text: Attract vista: the camera swings a 76° arc over the volcano's sunlit flank (it used to orbit a full circle, framing the shaded side half the time), and the storm cell no longer fills the screen when the camera flies through it.

A subtle bug fixed along the way: the very first animation frame's timestamp predated the loop's clock, so a negative dt inverted every smoothing filter at startup — the vista camera overshot ~1.5 km before settling. The clamp also makes the game robust to tab-restore jumps.

Sound on phone speakers: the wind bed now ducks harder and darker near the storm core so rain owns it, and crash/cut/rumble/respawn beats hand off instead of stacking. The exhaust flame got a hotter core and speed-reactive tail so it stays visible at pocket size.

One defect remains and is filed (#3411): a small black polygon sits over the far volcano in the attract vista on some machines — it predates this pass and survives hiding every nearby system, so it ships pinned-out but visible while it's chased.
